proposals.title: Stabilize WIP and machine feed with JIT dispatch rules
proposals.problem: Starvation risk index is 0.38 and route coverage requires operational validation.
root_causes: WIP too far from point of use
actions: Define near-line WIP cells by converter cadence and maximum stock age.
Dispatch replenishment by starvation risk, due date and route occupancy.
Use 30-45 minute JIT release windows and replan every 15-30 minutes.
Separate inbound and outbound flows at bottleneck intersections.
proposals.decision_gate: Pilot one converter loop before plant-wide rollout.

proposals.title: Recover OEE through loss Pareto, SMED and constraint control
proposals.problem: Estimated OEE 52.2% versus catalog midpoint 83.15%.
actions: Build a weekly OEE loss Pareto by availability, performance and quality.
Run SMED observation on the top two changeovers and externalize preparation.
Set centerline parameters and escalation limits for speed, quality and jams.
Review the bottleneck every shift and protect it from starvation and blockage.
proposals.decision_gate: Pilot when two weeks of machine-state and production counts are available.

proposals.title: Validate pedestrian, forklift and automated-flow segregation
proposals.problem: CAD topology can identify candidate conflicts, but it cannot prove safe clearances or regulatory compliance without calibrated scale and a site walkdown.
actions: Calibrate CAD units and verify aisle, doorway and turning-envelope dimensions on site.
Map pedestrian crossings, forklift lanes, blind corners, fire routes and exclusion zones.
Run task-based risk assessment for loading, charging, recovery and maintenance modes.
Require EHS sign-off before changing traffic rules or deploying AMRs.
proposals.decision_gate: No layout or AMR GO decision without calibrated geometry, site walkdown and EHS approval.

proposals.title: Reduce quality loss and trim waste with defect-at-source control
proposals.problem: No live scrap telemetry is connected; catalog quality-loss midpoint is 1.57% and must be validated.
actions: Measure scrap by machine, order, SKU, defect and shift at the point of generation.
Introduce first-piece approval and parameter recipe lock before full-speed production.
Run daily top-three defect Pareto with containment owner and due date.
Separate trim, startup waste and quality rejects to avoid masking root causes.
proposals.decision_gate: Replace benchmark assumption after four weeks of weighed site scrap data.

proposals.title: Move critical equipment from reactive to condition-based maintenance
proposals.problem: Layout identifies maintainable assets but no failure history or condition telemetry is connected.
actions: Rank assets by bottleneck role, safety, downtime cost and spare lead time.
Create PM standards for alignment, wear, lubrication, controls and guarding.
Add vibration, thermal or current checks to the top critical assets.
Run bad-actor review and RCA for every repeat failure above the downtime threshold.
proposals.decision_gate: Approve criticality matrix with maintenance and production owners.

proposals.title: Evaluate AMR only where flow stability and safety justify automation
proposals.problem: Current AMR assessment is recommended; no live mission, traffic or charging data is connected.
actions: Build an origin-destination matrix with peak transport demand and service SLA.
Simulate fleet sizes 4/6/8 with charging, blocked aisles and priority dispatch.
Validate lane width, crossings, fire routes, pedestrian segregation and recovery modes.
Run a time-boxed pilot and approve scale-up only against OEE, safety and response KPIs.
proposals.decision_gate: GO only after scenario score >= 0.75 and safety validation; PILOT at 0.60-0.74.

proposals.title: Stabilize WIP and machine feed with JIT dispatch rules
proposals.problem: Starvation risk index is 0.621 and route coverage requires operational validation.
root_causes: WIP too far from point of use
actions: Define near-line WIP cells by converter cadence and maximum stock age.
Dispatch replenishment by starvation risk, due date and route occupancy.
Use 30-45 minute JIT release windows and replan every 15-30 minutes.
Separate inbound and outbound flows at bottleneck intersections.
proposals.decision_gate: Pilot one converter loop before plant-wide rollout.

proposals.title: Validate pedestrian, forklift and automated-flow segregation
proposals.problem: CAD topology can identify candidate conflicts, but it cannot prove safe clearances or regulatory compliance without calibrated scale and a site walkdown.
actions: Calibrate CAD units and verify aisle, doorway and turning-envelope dimensions on site.
Map pedestrian crossings, forklift lanes, blind corners, fire routes and exclusion zones.
Run task-based risk assessment for loading, charging, recovery and maintenance modes.
Require EHS sign-off before changing traffic rules or deploying AMRs.
proposals.decision_gate: No layout or AMR GO decision without calibrated geometry, site walkdown and EHS approval.

proposals.title: Reduce quality loss and trim waste with defect-at-source control
proposals.problem: No live scrap telemetry is connected; catalog quality-loss midpoint is 1.57% and must be validated.
actions: Measure scrap by machine, order, SKU, defect and shift at the point of generation.
Introduce first-piece approval and parameter recipe lock before full-speed production.
Run daily top-three defect Pareto with containment owner and due date.
Separate trim, startup waste and quality rejects to avoid masking root causes.
proposals.decision_gate: Replace benchmark assumption after four weeks of weighed site scrap data.

proposals.title: Recover OEE through loss Pareto, SMED and constraint control
proposals.problem: Estimated OEE 97.0% versus catalog midpoint 83.15%.
actions: Build a weekly OEE loss Pareto by availability, performance and quality.
Run SMED observation on the top two changeovers and externalize preparation.
Set centerline parameters and escalation limits for speed, quality and jams.
Review the bottleneck every shift and protect it from starvation and blockage.
proposals.decision_gate: Pilot when two weeks of machine-state and production counts are available.

proposals.title: Move critical equipment from reactive to condition-based maintenance
proposals.problem: Layout identifies maintainable assets but no failure history or condition telemetry is connected.
actions: Rank assets by bottleneck role, safety, downtime cost and spare lead time.
Create PM standards for alignment, wear, lubrication, controls and guarding.
Add vibration, thermal or current checks to the top critical assets.
Run bad-actor review and RCA for every repeat failure above the downtime threshold.
proposals.decision_gate: Approve criticality matrix with maintenance and production owners.

proposals.title: Evaluate AMR only where flow stability and safety justify automation
proposals.problem: Current AMR assessment is recommended; no live mission, traffic or charging data is connected.
actions: Build an origin-destination matrix with peak transport demand and service SLA.
Simulate fleet sizes 4/6/8 with charging, blocked aisles and priority dispatch.
Validate lane width, crossings, fire routes, pedestrian segregation and recovery modes.
Run a time-boxed pilot and approve scale-up only against OEE, safety and response KPIs.
proposals.decision_gate: GO only after scenario score >= 0.75 and safety validation; PILOT at 0.60-0.74.

Run SMED observation on the top two changeovers and externalize preparation.

Review the bottleneck every shift and protect it from starvation and blockage.
proposals.decision_gate: Pilot when two weeks of machine-state and production counts are available.

proposals.decision_gate: Replace benchmark assumption after four weeks of weighed site scrap data.

proposals.title: Stabilize WIP and machine feed with JIT dispatch rules
proposals.problem: Starvation risk index is 0.38 and route coverage requires operational validation.
root_causes: WIP too far from point of use
actions: Define near-line WIP cells by converter cadence and maximum stock age.
Dispatch replenishment by starvation risk, due date and route occupancy.
Use 30-45 minute JIT release windows and replan every 15-30 minutes.
Separate inbound and outbound flows at bottleneck intersections.
proposals.decision_gate: Pilot one converter loop before plant-wide rollout.

proposals.title: Recover OEE through loss Pareto, SMED and constraint control
proposals.problem: Estimated OEE 52.2% versus catalog midpoint 83.15%.
actions: Build a weekly OEE loss Pareto by availability, performance and quality.
Run SMED observation on the top two changeovers and externalize preparation.
Set centerline parameters and escalation limits for speed, quality and jams.
Review the bottleneck every shift and protect it from starvation and blockage.
proposals.decision_gate: Pilot when two weeks of machine-state and production counts are available.

proposals.title: Validate pedestrian, forklift and automated-flow segregation
proposals.problem: CAD topology can identify candidate conflicts, but it cannot prove safe clearances or regulatory compliance without calibrated scale and a site walkdown.
actions: Calibrate CAD units and verify aisle, doorway and turning-envelope dimensions on site.
Map pedestrian crossings, forklift lanes, blind corners, fire routes and exclusion zones.
Run task-based risk assessment for loading, charging, recovery and maintenance modes.
Require EHS sign-off before changing traffic rules or deploying AMRs.
proposals.decision_gate: No layout or AMR GO decision without calibrated geometry, site walkdown and EHS approval.

proposals.title: Reduce quality loss and trim waste with defect-at-source control
proposals.problem: No live scrap telemetry is connected; catalog quality-loss midpoint is 1.57% and must be validated.
actions: Measure scrap by machine, order, SKU, defect and shift at the point of generation.
Introduce first-piece approval and parameter recipe lock before full-speed production.
Run daily top-three defect Pareto with containment owner and due date.
Separate trim, startup waste and quality rejects to avoid masking root causes.
proposals.decision_gate: Replace benchmark assumption after four weeks of weighed site scrap data.

proposals.title: Move critical equipment from reactive to condition-based maintenance
proposals.problem: Layout identifies maintainable assets but no failure history or condition telemetry is connected.
actions: Rank assets by bottleneck role, safety, downtime cost and spare lead time.
Create PM standards for alignment, wear, lubrication, controls and guarding.
Add vibration, thermal or current checks to the top critical assets.
Run bad-actor review and RCA for every repeat failure above the downtime threshold.
proposals.decision_gate: Approve criticality matrix with maintenance and production owners.

proposals.title: Evaluate AMR only where flow stability and safety justify automation
proposals.problem: Current AMR assessment is recommended; no live mission, traffic or charging data is connected.
actions: Build an origin-destination matrix with peak transport demand and service SLA.
Simulate fleet sizes 4/6/8 with charging, blocked aisles and priority dispatch.
Validate lane width, crossings, fire routes, pedestrian segregation and recovery modes.
Run a time-boxed pilot and approve scale-up only against OEE, safety and response KPIs.
proposals.decision_gate: GO only after scenario score >= 0.75 and safety validation; PILOT at 0.60-0.74.
